6.1.en: A real renunciate isn't someone who quits everything. It's someone who does their duty without chasing rewards.
6.1.hi: Asli sanyasi woh nahi jo sab chhod de. Woh hai jo reward ke peeche bhaage bina apna kaam kare.

6.2.en: Letting go and selfless work are the same thing. You can't do either while still chasing what you want.
6.2.hi: Chhodna aur selfless kaam ek hi cheez hai. Apni chahat ke peeche bhaagte hue dono nahi ho sakte.

6.3.en: When you're starting out, action is the way. Once you've leveled up, calm is the way.
6.3.hi: Shuruaat mein action hi raasta hai. Level up hone ke baad shaanti raasta hai.

6.4.en: When you stop clinging to sense pleasures and to your actions, you've reached the top of yoga.
6.4.hi: Jab sense ke mazon aur apne karm se chipakna band ho jaaye, tab tum yoga ke top pe ho.

6.5.en: You can be your own best friend or your own worst enemy. Lift yourself up. Don't drag yourself down.
6.5.hi: Tum khud ke best friend bhi ho aur worst enemy bhi. Khud ko upar uthao, neeche mat kheecho.

6.6.en: Master your mind and it becomes your best friend. Leave it untamed and it acts like your enemy.
6.6.hi: Mind ko master karo toh woh best friend banta hai. Bekaabu chhodo toh dushman ki tarah behave karta hai.

6.7.en: With a calm, controlled mind you stay steady through heat or cold, praise or insults.
6.7.hi: Shaant aur controlled mind ke saath garmi-sardi, taareef-beizzati sab mein steady rehte ho.

6.8.en: To someone truly at peace, dirt, stone and gold are all the same. Status doesn't move them.
6.8.hi: Jo sach mein shaant hai, uske liye mitti, patthar aur sona sab same hai. Status unhe hila nahi sakta.

6.9.en: Friends, haters, family, strangers, good people and bad: treat them all with the same fairness. That's next level.
6.9.hi: Dost, haters, family, ajnabi, achhe aur bure: sabke saath ek jaisa insaaf. Ye next level hai.

6.10.en: Find some alone time daily. Quiet your thoughts, drop your wants, and just focus.
6.10.hi: Roz thoda alone time nikaalo. Thoughts shaant karo, chahatein chhodo, aur bas focus karo.

6.11.en: Set up a clean, comfortable spot, not too high or too low. Your meditation space matters.
6.11.hi: Ek saaf, comfortable jagah set karo, na zyada oonchi na neechi. Meditation space matter karta hai.

6.12.en: Sit there, focus your mind, control your senses, and practise to clear your inner self.
6.12.hi: Wahan baitho, mind focus karo, senses control karo, aur andar ki safai ke liye practice karo.

6.13.en: Back, neck and head straight. Stay still. Soft focus on the tip of your nose. No looking around.
6.13.hi: Kamar, gardan aur sar seedhe. Stable raho. Naak ki nok pe halka focus. Idhar-udhar mat dekho.

6.14.en: Stay calm and fearless, keep your discipline, and focus your mind on the Divine.
6.14.hi: Shaant aur nidar raho, discipline banaye rakho, aur mind ko Bhagwan pe focus karo.

6.15.en: Practise like this regularly and you'll reach a peace that's the highest kind there is.
6.15.hi: Aise regular practice karo toh woh peace milegi jo sabse oonchi hai.

6.16.en: Overeating or starving, oversleeping or pulling all-nighters: none of it works. Balance is the key.
6.16.hi: Zyada khaana ya bhookha rehna, zyada sona ya raat bhar jaagna: kuch kaam nahi karta. Balance hi key hai.

6.17.en: Balanced food, fun, work and sleep. That's how yoga actually ends your stress.
6.17.hi: Balanced khaana, masti, kaam aur neend. Aise hi yoga sach mein stress khatam karta hai.

6.18.en: When your mind rests in your true self and stops craving stuff, you're ready for real yoga.
6.18.hi: Jab mind apne asli self mein tike aur cheezon ki craving band ho, tab tum asli yoga ke liye ready ho.

6.19.en: Like a candle flame that doesn't flicker in a room with no wind. That's a focused mind.
6.19.hi: Jaise bina hawa wale kamre mein deepak ki lau nahi hilti. Waisa hota hai focused mind.

6.20.en: When practice settles the mind, you see your true self and feel joy just from that.
6.20.hi: Jab practice se mind settle hota hai, toh asli self dikhta hai aur usi se khushi milti hai.

6.21.en: There's a happiness beyond the senses that only a clear mind can feel. Once you find it, you don't slip.
6.21.hi: Ek khushi hai jo senses se pare hai, sirf clear mind feel kar sakta hai. Ek baar mil gayi toh fisalte nahi.

6.22.en: Once you've got it, nothing else compares. Even the hardest pain can't shake you.
6.22.hi: Ek baar mil gaya toh kuch aur compare nahi karta. Sabse bada dard bhi hila nahi sakta.

6.23.en: Yoga is literally disconnecting from suffering. Practise it with determination. Don't give up.
6.23.hi: Yoga ka matlab hai dukh se disconnect hona. Isse determination se practice karo. Haar mat maano.

6.24.en: Drop the wants your mind keeps cooking up, and pull your senses back from every direction.
6.24.hi: Mind jo chahatein bana raha hai unhe chhodo, aur senses ko har taraf se wapas kheencho.

6.25.en: Slowly, step by step, steady your mind with willpower and focus only on your true self.
6.25.hi: Dheere dheere, step by step, willpower se mind steady karo aur sirf apne asli self pe focus karo.

6.26.en: Mind wandering again? Totally normal. Gently bring it back, every single time. That's the whole practice.
6.26.hi: Mind phir bhaag gaya? Normal hai. Pyaar se wapas lao, har baar. Bas yahi practice hai.

6.27.en: Calm mind, no restlessness, no guilt. That yogi finds the highest happiness.
6.27.hi: Shaant mind, na bechaini, na guilt. Aise yogi ko sabse badi khushi milti hai.

6.28.en: Keep practising and stay clean inside, and supreme joy comes easily.
6.28.hi: Practice karte raho aur andar se saaf raho, toh sabse badi khushi aasaani se milti hai.

6.29.en: With a focused mind you see yourself in everyone and everyone in yourself. We're all connected.
6.29.hi: Focused mind se tum sab mein khud ko aur khud mein sabko dekhte ho. Hum sab connected hain.

6.30.en: See me in everyone and everyone in me, and we'll never lose each other.
6.30.hi: Mujhe sab mein aur sabko mujh mein dekho, toh hum kabhi ek dusre ko nahi khoyenge.

6.31.en: Love the Divine in every being, and however you live, you stay connected to me.
6.31.hi: Har jeev mein Bhagwan ko pyaar karo, phir chahe jaise bhi jiyo, mujhse jude rahoge.

6.32.en: Feel others' pain and joy as your own. That empathy is the highest kind of yoga.
6.32.hi: Dusron ka dukh-sukh apna samjho. Yahi empathy sabse ooncha yoga hai.

6.33.en: Arjuna: "This sounds great, but my mind is all over the place. How do I keep it steady?"
6.33.hi: Arjun: "Sunne mein achha hai, par mera mind idhar-udhar bhaagta hai. Steady kaise rakhun?"

6.34.en: "The mind is restless, stubborn and strong. Controlling it feels like trying to control the wind." So relatable.
6.34.hi: "Mind bechain, ziddi aur strong hai. Isse control karna hawa ko control karne jaisa lagta hai." Bahut relatable.

6.35.en: Krishna: "True, it's tough. But with practice and letting go, you can train it."
6.35.hi: Krishna: "Sach hai, mushkil hai. Par practice aur detachment se ise train kar sakte ho."

6.36.en: Without self-control yoga's hard. But with effort and the right method, anyone can do it.
6.36.hi: Bina self-control yoga mushkil hai. Par effort aur sahi tareeke se koi bhi kar sakta hai.

6.37.en: Arjuna: "What if someone tries with faith but slips up and doesn't make it? What happens to them?"
6.37.hi: Arjun: "Agar koi bharose se try kare par fisal jaaye aur na pahunch paaye? Uska kya hoga?"

6.38.en: "Do they lose both worlds and just vanish, like a cloud torn apart?" The fear of failing halfway.
6.38.hi: "Kya woh dono duniya kho ke gayab ho jaata hai, jaise phata hua baadal?" Beech mein fail hone ka darr.

6.39.en: "Krishna, only you can clear this doubt. Please answer."
6.39.hi: "Krishna, ye doubt sirf aap clear kar sakte ho. Please bataiye."

6.40.en: Krishna: "Nobody who tries to do good ever ends up lost. Not here, not after." Effort is never wasted.
6.40.hi: Krishna: "Jo achha karne ki koshish karta hai, woh kabhi khota nahi. Na yahan, na baad mein." Effort kabhi waste nahi.

6.41.en: They're reborn into a good, comfortable family to keep going. The universe saves your progress.
6.41.hi: Woh achhi, sukhi family mein phir paida hote hain taaki aage badh sakein. Universe tumhara progress save rakhta hai.

6.42.en: Or they're born into a family of wise people. That's a rare blessing.
6.42.hi: Ya gyaani logon ki family mein janam lete hain. Ye rare blessing hai.

6.43.en: They pick up the wisdom from their past life and push even harder. Like loading a saved game.
6.43.hi: Pichhle janam ka gyaan wapas mil jaata hai aur woh aur mehnat karte hain. Jaise saved game load karna.

6.44.en: Past practice pulls them forward almost automatically. Even curiosity about yoga lifts you higher.
6.44.hi: Purani practice unhe apne aap aage kheenchti hai. Yoga ke baare mein curiosity bhi tumhe upar uthati hai.

6.45.en: Keep striving sincerely, life after life, and you'll reach the highest goal.
6.45.hi: Dil se koshish karte raho, janam dar janam, aur sabse ooncha goal paa loge.

6.46.en: A yogi beats someone who only does tough discipline, only studies, or only does rituals. So be a yogi.
6.46.hi: Yogi sirf tapasya, sirf padhai ya sirf rituals karne walon se aage hai. Toh yogi bano.

6.47.en: And of all yogis, the one who loves me with full faith and heart is the closest to me.
6.47.hi: Aur sab yogiyon mein, jo poore bharose aur dil se mujhe pyaar karta hai, woh mere sabse kareeb hai.
